PursuingWithChips.note: Live goal row: target glyph, 'Pursuing goal', truncated objective, pause/edit/delete actions AND the loops/terminals/agents chips on the same row. Docked on a composer lip so the rounded-t/0.5px border reads correctly.

PausedGoal.note: phase=paused — objective drops to text-faint and the pause control becomes play. Correct derivation.

EditingObjective.note: defaultEditing swaps in the auto-growing GoalBarObjectiveEditor prefilled with the objective, with the ✗/✓ actions pinned top-right.

ComposingNewGoal.note: goal=null + composing renders the same editor blank with the 'Describe the goal to pursue' placeholder — the empty-state affordance.

StoppedResult.note: status=failed / nativeStatus=budgetLimited renders the sticky result row: destructive CircleAlert, 'Goal stopped', em-dashed objective, expand chevron and dismiss. (I used failed rather than blocked on purpose — blocked's glyph is text-warning, which is a 15%-alpha token and invisible; see learnings/G.md.)
